about: (2026-11-17, pipefix: WCW_WRESTLERS_DIR = qa\wrestlers_test, where 0x0322 lives.) playtest2 2026-11-16, the user's playtest item 2b: 'a separator line on the Titantron during videos'. Not settled on the CPU: no capture of it exists (visualfix's vf_tron_video is the game's cameras). This one holds the scenario's camera still on RAW IS WAR's screen (tron.c tron_place: centre 0, 710, 2695, 1160 wide) from the start, so the entrance videos fill a still frame; shots every 0.25 s while the entrances run. A folder wrestler (0x0322, qa/wrestlers_test: a native video) and the Rock (the game's own video). LOOK: a line across the screen -- where (the middle: the two halves the game draws into the 64 x 32 picture; the edge: the screen mesh's wrap; a panel joint: the arena's own screen parts), with which video (native or the game's), and whether 0.84's hold_edges removes it (run it on the 0.83 exe too). Crop the screen from each shot (x 380..900, y 120..420 of 1280 x 960 roughly) and compare rows: a row darker / lighter than both neighbours across the whole width is the line.

expect.name: the entrances ran
expect.check: mode == 0 and screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29
